limitations: This purposive, English-language, arXiv-heavy pass broadens the earlier LM emphasis but is not exhaustive. A selected primary abstract is not a theorem audit or independent validation. Explicit recent-work searches were uneven and sometimes returned unrelated subjects; foundational pairs do not establish the latest frontier. We did not measure search saturation or complete backward/forward citation traversal. The coverage ledger records thin areas and a specific next search for every subfield.
